Welcome to Med Aesthetics - by Donna M. Potter NP Explore Our Services BOTO X & FILLERS ® SKIN REJUVENATION COOLSCULPTING ® About ABOUT US What began as a simple spider vein practice in 2010, soon evolved into a thriving medical aesthetics practice built on something deeper than treatments alone. On Cape Cod, where community is close-knit and privacy matters, patients were seeking trusted clinical expertise delivered in a calm, quiet setting where they didn’t feel rushed, pressured, or “sold to.”​ That vision became Medical Aesthetics by Donna: a woman- and nurse practitioner-owned practice located on 6A in Yarmouthport, grounded in leading-edge science, personalized treatment, and genuine connection. All providers are Nurses or Nurse Practitioners. Through skilled, gentle hands, artistic vision, and innovative techniques using Botox®, fillers, laser, microneedling, CoolSculpting® and more, we help patients look and feel like the best version of themselves with an experience built on safety, trust, discretion and confidence. Scheduling is by appointment only and appointments are intentionally spaced to create privacy and avoid overlap. Doors are locked during procedures to minimize interruptions and maintain confidentiality.​ **We are medical providers and do not accept gratuities or tips. Our Dentists SERVICES Botox ® Botox® treats lines and wrinkles caused by muscle movement in the face. It stops the nerve innervation to the small face muscles which temporarily reduces or stops muscle from contraction, creating a smoother, less wrinkled appearance. Over time, these wrinkle lines will often soften, fade, reduce or resolve, creating a more natural and youthful appearance... Learn More Book Now Coolsculpting ® COOLSCULPTING ELITE ® is the newest and most advanced CoolSculpting technology on the market and reduces more fat per area than the former models. Common treatment areas are under the chin, belly and love handles, but it can work anywhere you have pinchable fat! Coolsculpting works by freezing and destroying fat in targeting areas where the stubborn fat lies. The fat then naturally dissipates over a 4–12-week period (8 weeks on average) for noticeable results... Learn More Book Now Fillers Haluronic acid (HA) fillers are manufactured gel fillers that are indicated for areas of volume loss throughout the face. They fill the space in areas of volume loss due to weight loss or aging, to reduce wrinkles, lift cheeks, and contour other areas of the face to give a more vibrant, natural, youthful appearance. Results are immediate for most fillers. HA is a natural protein in your body that slowly dissipates over time... Learn More Book Now Kybella Kybella is a fat reduction treatment that uses injectable Deoxycholic acid, naturally produced in your body, to destroy fat cells. This is FDA approved to be used with under chin fat, although has been used “off label” in others areas as well such as the jowls and knees. There is minimal downtime and results are often noticed in 4-6 weeks. 1-3 treatment sessions are often needed for best results. Learn More Book Now Spider Veins Face and Legs Spider veins are small purple, blue, and pink veins in and under the skin, mostly on the face and legs. On the face, they are easily eliminated using the Vein Gogh radiofrequency system. On the legs, Sclerotherapy, or an injected medication, is the gold standard of treatment. There is no down time with either treatment. Results are immediate on the face. Leg veins take several treatments 4-5 weeks apart for best results. Learn More Book Now Large Hand Veins With age, skin loses elasticity, thins, and becomes more transparent, causing large veins in the hands to become more visible, noticeable and appear bulgier. Rather than removing them and reducing possible IV access sites that may someday be needed, filler can be gently injected around these large hand veins, reducing their bulgy appearance. This allows for a more natural and youthful appearance while sparing the veins. Learn More Book Now PRX Derm Perfection PRX Derm Perfection Treatment is a cutting-edge skincare innovation developed by a female physician in Italy that combines science and beauty to deliver unmatched results. This treatment is designed to address a wide range of skin concerns, making it suitable for individuals of all ages and skin types. It does not cause sun sensitivity so is safe to use during the summer months! There are no needles, no downtime, no pain, and no peeling with this treatment. Only a beautiful tightening and glow! And it can be used all over the body for that crepey skin. ​ Learn More Book Now Tetra CoolPeel Laser CoolPeel is a new way to safely, and comfortably deliver the benefits of a traditional CO2 resurfacing treatment. By targeting just the superficial layer of skin tissue, damaged skin is removed revealing younger and healthier looking skin. ​ CO2 lasers are the gold standard in treating wrinkles, age spots, acne scars, and other blemishes as well as tightening skin and balancing tone. Damaged skin tissue is removed, or ablated, stimulating new collagen production and heat energy is delivered to tighten the skin. Traditionally CO2 treatments are often accompanied by considerable downtime and risk while damaged skin heals.Many advances have been made to improve the side effects of CO2 treatments but ONLY the CoolPeel can deliver a fractional ablative treatment without the downtime. There is minimal risk of hyperpigmentation, demarcation or induced infection. ​ ​ Learn More Book Now Sylfirm X Sylfirm X is one of the latest RF microneedling device on the market. It is the first and only FDA-registered device with both a Pulse Wave and Continuous Wave. This Radio Frequency Microneedling Device targets skin laxity and pigmentation for the ultimate skin rejuvenation. Sylfirm X uses non-insulated microneedle electrodes to cover all dermal layers with a uniform electric field to maximize results. By utilizing heat, this treatment stimulates collagen production in the deeper layers of the skin, resulting improvement in skin structure, causing a tighter and smoother surface... Learn More Book Now Regenerative Medicine ​Regenerative medicine in aesthetics focuses on harnessing the body’s own natural healing and restorative abilities to improve skin health, slow signs of aging, and enhance overall appearance. Instead of simply masking concerns, regenerative treatments—such as Platelet Derived Growth Factor(PDGF), platelet-rich plasma (PRP), exosomes, or stem-cell–based therapies—stimulate cellular repair, collagen production, and tissue regeneration. The goal is to achieve natural, long-lasting improvements in skin texture, tone, and vitality by working with the body’s biology rather than against it. ​ ​If you’re curious whether regenerative treatments are right for you, schedule a consultation today to explore your personalized options. Learn More Book Now Skinvive SKINVIVE™ by JUVÉDERM® is the first and only FDA-approved hyaluronic acid (HA) microdroplet injectable in the US to improve skin smoothness in the cheeks. It is considered a skin hydrator and improves skin quality. It is not a filler. It is sometimes used off label in the lips for those who want hydration instead of plumping and in the upper lip (smoker) lines. It is indicated for those with dull, dry skin and best for those who want to improve texture, fine lines, and dehydration. It is injected directly into the dermis to give an extra boost of hydration and glow! It can be added on to other treatments the same day, such as botox, and it can last up to 6 months... Learn More Book Now Cocktails PRP/PDGF/Biostimulators/HA Cocktails are a cutting edge treatment intended to thicken "crepey" skin and can be used on the face, neck, and hands. The formulas use your own Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP), Platelet Derived Growth Factor (PDGF), Biostimulator (Radiesse), and/or Hyaluronic acid (HA) combined with Neurotoxins (Botox or Xeomin) and other FDA approved products. The liquids are mixed with the other ingredients and injected superficially under the skin using both cannula and needle techniques. injections stimulate your body to produce collagen to improve skin quality and structure, making the outcomes of the treatment very natural. Improvement in skin texture is noticeable in approximately 3 weeks. Full collagen stimulation takes at least 3 months. Once this collagen is produced, the anti-aging effects are expected to last up to two years. This treatment causes very little down time. Generally 2 treatments are recommended 4-6 weeks apart for best results. Learn More Book Now Diamond Glow Skin Treatment The Diamond Glow treatment is a non-invasive, medical-grade facial that deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and nourishes the skin in one advanced procedure. Using a diamond-tipped wand, it gently removes dead skin cells while simultaneously extracting impurities and infusing customized serums into the freshly resurfaced skin. This process improves texture, enhances radiance, and leaves the complexion instantly smoother, brighter, and more hydrated with no downtime. ​ ​ Learn More Book Now MicroTox, NasalTox, Theratox ® ® ® Innovative use and technique developed at InjectAbility Institute outside Los Angeles, CA which accelerates the effects of Botox®, producing an instant tightening and lifting result. The skin will subsequently appear to be tighter and more compressed which allows fine lines to dissipate. No more waiting 3-7 days for your Botox® to take effect! You will walk out of the office with a smoother, tighter lift to your face or neck. • Instantly tightens skin on face, eyes and neck • Slims jawline, reducing jowls and 'wattle" • Softens crow's feet and opens up eyes • Eyelid and brow lifting • Under Eye Crepiness • Cheek Crepiness • Facial Tightening- Decreases pore size • Facial Flushing- Facial sweating • Softens a pebbly chin • Subtle enhancing of the lips • Recontours and slims nose • Neck and Décolletage tightening Learn More Book Now Periluxe™ Lipline Refinement ​ Created by Donna Potter, NP, the PeriLuxe™ Lipline Refinement Technique is her proprietary, signature approach to treating the delicate area surrounding the lips. This specialized treatment is designed to soften the appearance of vertical lip lines, restore a smoother and more youthful contour around the mouth, and help improve lipstick retention by creating a more refined lip border. ​ Unlike treatments that simply add volume to the lips, the PeriLuxe™ Technique focuses specifically on the fine lines and textural changes that develop around the mouth as part of the natural aging process. Using advanced injection techniques and an artistic, individualized approach, we carefully refine this area while preserving natural movement and facial expression—helping you look refreshed, not overdone. ​ Every treatment plan is customized to each patient's unique anatomy and aesthetic goals, providing subtle, elegant results that enhance your natural beauty while maintaining facial harmony. The result is a smoother, softer, and more confident smile with beautifully natural-looking rejuvenation. ​ ​ Learn More Book Now Testimonials Contact Us Send me a message, including your name, and I'll get back to you shortly!
